title: deployment_c06-analyzer-engines-in-container data contracts
description: Image-level contract (env + bundled engine layout) plus the runtime self-check shape that makes analyzer-engine readiness observable. No change to the existing PcbVerifyResult/simulate result vocabulary — the fix makes the engines resolvable so the existing 'pass|warn|fail|skipped-no-simulator' verdicts can be produced instead of 'skipped-no-skills'.

BundledEngineEnv.description: Image ENV set by Dockerfile / Dockerfile.ee. Each points at a directory whose child 'scripts/' must exist for resolve_skill to qualify it.

AnalyzerEngineReadiness.description: Per-engine readiness reported by the deployment self-check (DD-5). Distinguishes a missing engine script (would cause skipped-no-skills) from a missing binary (honest skipped-no-simulator).

engine_resolvable.description: resolve_skill(engine, env) returned a non-None Path (scripts/ present)

binary_present.description: the engine's underlying binary is on PATH (kicad-cli for kicad/emc/thermal; ngspice for spice)

resolved_path.description: the path resolve_skill returned, or null

image_role.description: core is expected to forward EE and may report engines absent by design

C06VerdictStatus.description: Existing verdict vocabulary (unchanged). The fix removes 'skipped-no-skills' from the default deployment's reachable set by making engines resolvable; 'skipped-no-simulator' remains legitimate when a binary is genuinely absent.
